'''Anne-Laure Dalibard''' is a French mathematician working on [[asymptotic behavior]] of fluid equations occurring in [[Oceanography|oceanographic]] models. She works as a staff scientist at the Jacques-Louis Lions Laboratory, a [[Unité_mixte_de_recherche|joint research unit]] between [[Sorbonne University]] and the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research]] (UMR 7598.)

== Education and career ==
Dalibard earned her PhD from [[Sorbonne University]],<ref>[https://ljll.math.upmc.fr/dalibard/CV/CV_dalibard_UK.pdf Anne-Laure Dalibard CV, Laboratoire Jacques-Louis Lions] </ref> working on the homogenization of scalar conservation laws and transport equations<ref>[https://ljll.math.upmc.fr/dalibard/these/these_dalibard.pdf Homogenization of scalar conservation laws and transport equations]</ref> under the supervision of [[Fields Medal]] laureate [[Pierre-Louis Lions]].

== Awards and honours ==
* 2023 Mathematics medal of the [[French Academy of Sciences]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Laureats/laureats-2023-des-prix-thematiques.html|title=Lauréats 2023 des prix thématiques |language=fr|publisher=French Academy of Sciences|access-date=2024-08-09}}</ref>
* 2020 [[Société Mathématique de France]] Maurice Audin Prize <ref>[https://www.insmi.cnrs.fr/fr/cnrsinfo/prix-maurice-audin-2020 Prix Maurice Audin 2020, CNRS]</ref>
* 2018 [[CNRS]] bronze medal<ref>[https://www.cnrs.fr/en/node/1894 CNRS bronze medal 2018 – Anne-Laure Dalibard, CNRS]</ref>
* 2015 [[ERC_Starting_Grant|European Research Council starting grant]]
* 2010 [[College de France]] Peccot Prize<ref>[https://www.college-de-france.fr/site/en-cours-peccot/Presentation.htm Cours Peccot, College de France ]</ref>
